brand_identity.name: BESLENCE AI
brand_identity.tagline: Yediklerini, aktivitelerini ve günlük akışını tek yerden takip et.
brand_identity.vibe: Premium, modern, sade (clean), soft edges, smooth animations.
brand_identity.logo_concept: 'B' body with a single sprouting leaf on top.
brand_identity.signature_animation: Leaf filling up from bottom to top like water, representing daily progress or loading state.

typography.rules: The Anti-Default Rule: Headers use Poppins (distinct, geometric but friendly), Body uses Inter (clean, legible). Tighten tracking on large Poppins headers.

layout_and_spacing.mobile_first_container: Since this is a mobile app MVP (Expo style), wrap the main layout in a mobile container: `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative bg-[#F9FAF9] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl`.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use `p-6` or `p-8` for screen padding. Gap between dashboard cards should be `gap-4` or `gap-6`.
layout_and_spacing.grid_modes: Use Bento grid (Control Room mode) for dashboard macros: Main Calorie Summary `col-span-full`, smaller macro blocks `col-span-1` (Grid cols 2 or 3).

sakin_mod.description: Default. Calmer, focused on meals, water, and fiber.
sakin_mod.visuals: Soft shadows (`shadow-sm`), rounded edges (`rounded-3xl`), Paper background (`#F9FAF9`). Primary CTA uses Beslence Yeşili.
sakin_mod.dashboard_priority: Calories remaining, water intake progress, fiber, macros.

sportif_mod.visuals: Higher contrast. Cards might use Gece Yeşili (`#0B2620`) with Mint text for a 'dark mode' widget feel. Slightly sharper edges (`rounded-2xl`).
sportif_mod.dashboard_priority: Calories burned, protein intake, activity timeline.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1D9E75] text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-poppins font-medium shadow-[0_8px_24px_rgba(29,158,117,0.3)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-[#E0F5EE] text-[#0F6E56] rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-poppins font-medium hover:bg-[#c9eee2] transition-colors
buttons.fab: Floating Action Button for adding food/activity. Fixed bottom-right, size 16x16, Beslence Yeşili background, shadow-lg.

cards.base: bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(11,38,32,0.03)] border border-[#E0F5EE]/50

daily_timeline.line: absolute left-4 top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-[#E0F5EE]
daily_timeline.bubble_icon: absolute -left-8 w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-4 border-[#F9FAF9] z-10 text-white shadow-sm
daily_timeline.bubble_content: bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-[#E0F5EE]/50 flex-1

calendar_strip.description: Horizontal scrollable week view at the top of the dashboard.
calendar_strip.day_cell_active: bg-[#0B2620] text-white rounded-full px-3 py-4 flex flex-col items-center gap-1
calendar_strip.day_cell_inactive: text-[#5B7A72] rounded-full px-3 py-4 flex flex-col items-center gap-1
calendar_strip.indicators: Small colored dots under the date (Green=Meal, Blue=Water logged).

bottom_navigation.container: absolute bottom-0 w-full bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-gray-100 pb-safe pt-4 px-6 flex justify-between items-center rounded-t-3xl z-50

animations.signature_leaf_fill: Use Framer Motion. SVG Leaf path. Animate `clipPath: inset(100% 0 0 0)` to `inset(0% 0 0 0)` over 1.5s with an ease-out curve. Background leaf is Mint, fill is Beslence Yeşili.
animations.page_transitions: Slide up and fade in (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`).
animations.timeline_bubbles: Staggered fade-in from the left (`initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}`).

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK: Standard React web simulating a mobile app. Use a `max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative overflow-x-hidden bg-[#F9FAF9]` container to wrap the entire app.
FONTS: Import 'Poppins' (weights 400,500,600,700) and 'Inter' (weights 400,500) from Google Fonts in index.html or layout. Extend tailwind.config.js to include these font families.
ROUTING: Build views for Splash/Onboarding, Dashboard, Add Entry (Food/Activity), and Chatbot. Use conditional rendering or React Router.
UI LIBRARY: Heavily customize Shadcn primitives. Remove default borders and make them rounded-3xl or rounded-2xl based on Sakin/Sportif themes.
ICONS: Use 'lucide-react'. Specifically, use icons like Leaf, Droplets, Coffee, Activity, Calendar, MessageCircle.
DATA-TESTID: ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav items, inputs, cards) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="add-food-button"').
THEMES: Implement a state toggle for 'Sakin Mod' vs 'Sportif Mod'. Change CSS classes dynamically based on this state (e.g., switch highlight colors or reorder dashboard widgets).
CHATBOT: The chatbot is 'record-only'. Provide an interface with a microphone icon that simulates voice recording (visual equalizer or pulsing circle) and appends to the daily timeline.
NO PLACEHOLDERS: Use the image URLs provided in this JSON. Never use dummyimage.com.
